authority: Pinned Store closure is reconstructed from ordinary selection roots and compared with supplied embedded knowledge; check-selection and emit-core independently replay semantic admission.
Only JavaScript artifact switching is enabled; exact artifact bytes are reproduced with the bound compiler. Unsupported target replay or incomplete baseline work retains checked baseline.
Prices, physical features and canonical diagnostic definitions never grant equality, application conditions or correctness of target lowering.
binding_and_cohort: Exact original/selected core, selection, emitted artifact, fixture, instrumenter, trace and optional boundary bridge bytes are reauthenticated.
Ranking requires identical original source, entry, fixture id/hash and exact target/host/boundary/emitter/ABI cohort. Required unknown counts decline ranking.
Canonical import preserves diagnostic namespaces, original model JSON text, all five raw sample rounds and label/source provenance separately from proof objects.
training_and_generalization: Freeze accepts only declared training operation/size/split rows and five unique rounds; heldout timing input is opened only by evaluate after models/predictions are frozen.
Coefficient fitting reports low rank, unsupported columns and missing cohort support; predictions/errors/unavailable rows and losing choices remain visible.
Heldout evaluation compares distinct compiler cohorts descriptively at matching host/target/boundary/ABI/source/fixture, intentionally removing only emitter identity for the comparison.

Executed exact-fixture features include output-dependent work; acquisition/setup is excluded. This is offline target-work ranking, not a cheap online predictor, general speed proof or target parity proof.
limitations: Inputs/models/traces remain untrusted diagnostic proposals. Path/hash authentication binds bytes, not their truth or target semantics.
Training-source provenance does not by itself establish honest raw measurements; separate raw-sample audit and serial gate are necessary.
Feature index permits arbitrary split/version strings; protocol and acquired frozen matrix must enforce the intended concrete domains. No current matrix defect identified.

Selection output is reread from its path after replay; consumption still requires ordinary checker replay. Publishing workflows should bind the final returned package hash to the admitted candidate receipt to avoid concurrent drift.
